configurations.comment: Mirrors the root `dev:web` script: server components use the Admin SDK, which needs an explicit project id + emulator hosts or it throws 'unable to detect a project id'. Requires `pnpm emulators` running.
configurations.name: web-emulators
runtimeArgs: cd apps/web && FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 GCLOUD_PROJECT=carbid-staging GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=carbid-staging NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=carbid-staging npx next dev --port 3012
